pit_lineage_requirements.lineage_reason: FMP symbol rows must be linked to reviewed ticker / CIK / security-master identity before historical use.
Stable endpoint mode must be recorded so legacy v3 failures and future endpoint changes are not mixed silently.
Limit, period, from / to, and timeseries parameters determine which rows are present and must be replayable.
Fetch time is needed to distinguish observed-date eligibility from later provider revisions or endpoint drift.
Filing date is a necessary but not sufficient observed-date input for statement rows.
Accepted date or an equivalent reviewed timestamp is required before using statement rows as historical evidence.
Report period date must be separate from observed date to avoid treating period-end data as already observable.
Fiscal year and period are required for quarterly / annual row matching and duplicate-row checks.
Income, balance-sheet, cash-flow, and derived metrics need separate semantics and cross-check rules.
Historical evidence must define how amended filings, provider restatements, and revised values change or invalidate rows.
Latest/current endpoint values must be explicitly excluded from historical evidence unless a later review proves as-of semantics.
Units and currency scaling must be recorded to prevent cross-company or cross-period factor drift.
Duplicate, missing, absent ratio, or blank fields must block, defer, or flag records rather than silently default.
SEC EDGAR cross-check references are required for anomaly review, while SEC remains audit-only and not a replacement price or free-float source.
Every historical FMP row must have a reviewed rule for when it becomes eligible at a specific as-of date.

decision_gates.required_resolution: Any additional FMP endpoint calls, broader symbols, paid access, trial, or new token require separate explicit user approval and reviewed no-secret summary.
Validate observed-date, revision, restatement, duplicate, unit, currency, and as-of eligibility semantics before historical use.
Latest/current endpoint values must remain excluded from historical evidence until a later review proves as-of semantics.
Define exact SEC EDGAR anomaly cross-check mapping for FMP statement fields before production or DataHub use.
Historical EOD price / volume requires a separate reviewed adjustment, split, dividend, delisting, and missing-session semantics contract.
Phase 7c, DataHub, adapters, and production runners remain blocked until Phase 7b provider blockers are closed or explicitly accepted in a reviewed decision.

limitations: This artifact performs no FMP endpoint calls, raw payload parsing, field mapping implementation, provider contact, data fetch, adapter work, DataHub work, runner change, broker automation, or ship-gate claim.

Two-symbol field presence proves only response shape for active AAPL / MSFT samples; it does not prove field-level PIT, revision behavior, restatement behavior, coverage, adjustment semantics, or production readiness.
